description: This file implements functions related to handling QUIC protocol tags, including conversion between string and numeric representations, mutual tag detection, and tag parsing.

methods.name: FindMutualQuicTag
methods.description: Finds a common QuicTag in two tag vectors and optionally returns its index.

methods.name: QuicTagToString
methods.description: Converts a QuicTag to its string representation, either as ASCII characters or hex.

methods.name: MakeQuicTag
methods.description: Creates a QuicTag from four individual bytes.

methods.name: ContainsQuicTag
methods.description: Checks if a QuicTag exists within a vector of tags.

methods.name: ParseQuicTag
methods.description: Parses a string into a QuicTag, supporting hex and character formats.

methods.name: ParseQuicTagVector
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string into a vector of QuicTags.
